rationale: The workflow installs Python dependencies with uv on every run across a 3-platform x 4-Python-version matrix plus a separate Rust-backend job, with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) reports a measured benefit for caching dependency downloads, and the experiment batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2 shows adding actions/cache for the dependency cache reduced elapsed time (~9.2%) while keeping all checks intact. Adding an actions/cache step for the uv cache directory (~/.cache/uv), keyed on uv.lock and pyproject.toml with restore-keys, preserves every existing test step and required check while avoiding repeated dependency downloads. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or publishing steps are added, and no new network access beyond the standard Actions cache service is introduced.
